findings.original_claim: Color names given without rubric or reliability bands.
findings.required_change: Add coursebook rubric: Blue outstanding exceptional approach/multiple strengths or significant strength; Purple good thorough approach/at least one strength; Green acceptable adequate approach; Yellow marginal inadequate demonstration; Red unacceptable deficiency/unawardable. The illustrative MTBCF bands are blue>=130h, purple100-<130h, green70-<100h, yellow40-<70h, red<40h. State these are classroom bands, not universal ratings. Cite pp13-14.
findings.explanation: Visual audit found substantive missing teaching.

findings.original_claim: Exercise has proposal inputs but no checked comparative result or recognition that price is missing.
findings.required_change: Add worked comparison: Both meet the six stated thresholds on supplied data. A is stronger in payload/endurance/fuel consumption; B in sprint speed/offload time. Aviation is split: A deck2/hangar1, B deck1/hangar2, so neither meets the complete two-aircraft objective. A mission/payload/endurance-prioritized ranking favors A technically; speed/troop delivery priorities can favor B. The source gives no prices, so no final best-value or LPTA winner can be established. Choose weights/standards before reading proposals and do not simply average colors. Cite pp18-22 and FAR-Overhaul-Part15-2026.
findings.source_basis: Coursebook pp18-22 plus RFO best-value principles
findings.explanation: Makes TLO3 executable and avoids fabricated award answer.
